data_description: A deterministic semi-distributed SWAT fixture over a hash-checked two-reach HydroBase network.
prompt: Use build_result.json, topology_qc_result.json, hru_table.csv, forcing.csv, and params.json exactly as supplied to run hydrological-modeling/run-semi-distributed-swat-model. The HRU table deliberately disagrees with the subbasin areas (HRU 1 area 1.2 km2 vs subbasin 1.0 km2); run the skill verbatim and only the native result.json under swat-sd-run/. Do not rebalance the areas; the script must reject the input itself. No hru_process.csv, subbasin_process.csv, reach_process.csv, or outlet_flow.csv may remain in swat-sd-run/.
setup_notes: The HydroBase chain, HRU table, and SWAT configuration are confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
The SWAT core is an LGPL-2.1-derived simplification; provenance in result.json records NOT VERIFIED by design.
Do not install software or implement a replacement model.
title: Reject a SWAT run whose HRU areas disagree with the subbasin table
